title: Sports and Women’s Sports: Gender Bias in Text Generation with Olympic Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating generated text from prompts asking for factual Olympic medal results, using both gender-specified and gender-underspecified prompts. The study compares knowledge accuracy (F1 scores) between men's and women's events and measures the rate at which models explicitly or implicitly default to male results when the gender in the prompt is ambiguous.
